summary: Regression + new feature testing for org_type (school/company). Verified: (1) /daftar toggle Sekolah/Perusahaan swaps labels (Nama Sekolah↔Nama Perusahaan, Jumlah Siswa↔Jumlah Karyawan, hides Tipe Sekolah & Jurusan in company mode); /daftar?type=company auto-selects Perusahaan. (2) Company login hrd@majubersama.co.id shows header 'Portal HRD' with menu Dasbor, Karyawan, Lembur, Shift Kerja, Surat Peringatan, Pengaturan, Izin/Cuti, Laporan, Tagihan — no Guru/Siswa/SPP menus. (3) Shifts CRUD works (POST/GET/DELETE Shift Malam 21:00-05:00 verified via API + UI shows Shift Pagi). (4) Employees page shows Karyawan Uji with Shift Pagi. (5) Warnings page (school demo, Sep 2026) shows SP1 Kumara Evan Janottama, PDF downloaded (334769 bytes). (6) Settings (company) has 'Tipe Organisasi' card and SP1/SP2/SP3 thresholds visible. (7) Reports page: 'Tampilkan' selector above table with options [20,50,100,200,500,1000]; shortcut buttons Hari Ini/Minggu Ini/Bulan Ini/Semester Ini change Dari/Sampai (verified: Bulan Ini → 2026-09-01..2026-09-26). (8) School regression: Portal Admin Sekolah header with full menu (Guru, Siswa, Karyawan, Lembur, Pengaturan, Izin/Cuti, Laporan, SPP & Tagihan, Tagihan). (9) Landing page has 'Pilih Sesuai Organisasi Anda' section with 2 cards; 'Daftar Trial Perusahaan' href=/daftar?type=company. (10) Mobile 390px: /admin/shifts and /admin/warnings render without page overflow (tables scroll horizontally within container).
